title: Follow project replies
responsibility: Keeps public replies, changed-unit references, failures and saved plans in the project conversation.

inputs.name: projectAgentEvents.agent
inputs.description: The mutable project-agent object whose run and conversation state receive the event. The handler ignores the event unless this agent has a nonempty active run id equal to the event's runId.

inputs.name: projectAgentEvents.value
inputs.description: A desktop bridge event carrying a runId and event-specific data for status, replay, text, failure, cancellation or completion. It matters only when its runId matches the agent's nonempty active run; terminal events can refresh the workspace and open a saved thread.

outputs.name: projectAgentEvents
outputs.description: A promise that resolves with undefined after processing the event, or immediately when its runId does not match the agent's active run. Terminal handling refreshes the workspace and can load deployments and navigate to a saved thread; uncaught handling errors reject the promise.

errors.name: Propagated error
errors.description: An exception raised while handling the event or recording a message, and rejections from terminal workspace refresh, optional deployment loading, or saved-thread setup and navigation, propagate through this promise. The handler does not catch or normalize these failures.
